YiShu home

YiShu, wherever you read

An English companion to the I Ching, with the Chinese classics alongside it.

Explore the Book of Changes

Browse all 64 gua with English names, explanations of the judgment and imagery, practical reflections, and paraphrases of all 384 line statements. Search by English name, pinyin, Chinese name, or number.

Try a Plum Blossom number reading, toss three coins, explore the traditional hours, and save readings on your own device. VIP tools add calendar and solar terms, birth-date lookup, related hexagrams, and name or relationship readings. VIP access requires a publisher code.

The English explanations are original interpretive paraphrases. They offer a way to understand the traditional imagery; other interpretations are possible.

Use it on the web

Open the browser edition on a phone, tablet, or computer. No installation or account is needed for the public tools.

Open YiShu

Android · version 1.3.0

For Android 8.0 and later. Download the signed APK, open it on your phone, and allow installation from your download app if Android asks. The public tools and English library work offline.

Download Android APK

Updates use the same signing certificate as earlier YiShu releases.

Windows · version 1.3.0

Portable app for Windows x64. Extract the entire ZIP folder, then run YiShu.exe. Microsoft Edge WebView2 Runtime is required. The English website files are bundled for offline use.

Download Windows ZIP

This publisher-built portable app has no Windows code-signing certificate.
